defects.evidence: proposal _m_journal_diff (fields=list(row.get('differing_journal_fields') or []); append extra name); obligation findings[1] and interop note 'journal-diff-falsified on rows[].differing_journal_fields it never reads'; findings[1] fix 'diff all 12 fields via _typed'
defects.reason: journal-diff-falsified/_m_journal_diff only appends a name to rows[].differing_journal_fields; it does not alter adapter/source journal EXTRA or source_generation. Obligation findings state implement never reads that retained list and that the correct check is re-derived typed diff of all EXTRA+source_generation fields. A correct re-deriving inspector and the broken implement can both leave detected=False, so the control cannot fail specifically for the intended journal-relation defect.

defects.evidence: proposal want lambda for identity-origin-bound-to-nonstage-event; _nonstage_event fallback return; need text 'only re-deriving the last-unchanged stage origin catches it'; obligation findings[3] on stage-origin vs any in-range event
defects.reason: identity-origin-bound-to-nonstage-event's want predicate only requires a dict source_origin and nonempty events; _nonstage_event falls back to min(i, max(len(events)-1,0)) when every event is stage, so the mutation may cite a real stage event and fail to exercise 'last-unchanged stage origin' discrimination claimed in the control need text.

defects.evidence: proposal _witness/_rows; prefix-certificate-dropped want bool(c.get('prefixes')); obligation findings[0] 'case.get(rows) or []' vs control-build len(rows)==n-1 and len(px)==n; fixture 'valid case minus rows/prefixes'
defects.reason: _witness only iterates i in range(1, len(_rows(case))+1). Cases with prefixes or incarnation_pairs but empty/missing rows (explicit implement/control inventory asymmetry in findings[0]) cannot witness prefix-certificate-dropped, identity-*, or pair controls even when those shapes exist—systematic missing-witness under the adversarial inventory fixture the packet names.

defects.evidence: proposal _m_journal_diff next(f for f in ...); attempt() except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError)
defects.reason: _m_journal_diff uses next(...) over candidate field names; if all candidates are already listed, StopIteration is not among the mutation handler's caught types (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError), so run_controls can abort mid-suite instead of recording mutation-error.

defects.evidence: proposal run_controls charge.take(1) sites vs reference durable_precharge(plan_bytes), LocalControlCounter, require(book.used==book.limits), require(tuple(...)==CONTROL_LABELS); review_questions[3]
defects.reason: Accounting is only charge.take(1) before mutation, replay, and baseline. Unlike reference boundary_controls, there is no durable canonical plan/receipt, no exact local limit book with used==limits, no fixed CONTROL_LABELS completeness require, and no separation that prevents inspect_cases internal work from being mis-attributed. Enumeration and failure conservatism are under-specified for lead integration.

defects.evidence: proposal entry['detected']= (status=='counterexample'); reference _call exact_exception and attributed reason_fragments; integrity-binding note admits outer-hash ambiguity only for that kind
defects.reason: Detection is solely status=='counterexample' with no expected exception/reason-fragment attribution. Reference classifies exact exception types and reason fragments to avoid counting unrelated rejections as semantic hits; this runner can mark detected=True/False without proving the mutation was caught for the declared obligation reason.

defects.evidence: proposal controls list (journal-diff-falsified metadata; journal-staged-patch-forged integrity-binding only); obligation findings[1] on collection/attempts/source_revision and typed exact()
defects.reason: Suite lacks a semantic control that forges an actual mirrored journal value (e.g. collection/attempts/source_revision or bool/int drift) while preserving hashes via a declared integrity path or clear integrity-binding carve-out—the gap named by findings[1] remains unprobed except by the weak differing_journal_fields metadata mutation and a separate integrity-binding staged_source patch.

defects.evidence: proposal _dc isinstance(x, dict) return {k:_dc(v)...}; comment 'preserving the typed schema'; reference copy.deepcopy
defects.reason: _dc uses isinstance(..., dict) and rebuilds a plain dict, so dict subclasses lose type; reference uses copy.deepcopy. Low practical risk for JSON-like retained cases but weaker typed-schema preservation than claimed in the _dc comment.

required_checks: Replace or repair journal-diff-falsified so the mutation changes actual journal-comparable fields (or adapter journal patch content) that a correct typed EXTRA+source_generation diff must reject, and confirm a correct inspector detects it while still exposing implement's 4-field MIRROR gap.
Tighten identity-origin-bound-to-nonstage-event want/_nonstage_event to require a reachable non-stage event index; otherwise mark unavailable/missing-witness.
Decouple _witness from rows-only iteration (or add shape-specific witness finders) so prefixes/incarnation_pairs controls run when those inventories exist without rows.
Catch StopIteration (and ideally Exception) on mutate into mutation-error; add a semantic journal-field forge control covering findings[1] types.

Add fixed control-label inventory, explicit reservation plan vs charge.take accounting, and reason-attributed detection criteria before lead review; statically confirm no scientific imports and that integrity-binding results are never counted as semantic passes.

Cross-run (when execution is separately authorized) against both o17 inspect implementations to verify the packet's claimed 3/8 under-detection set and that repairs close journal-diff, prefix-drop, and pair-shift gaps without false positives on an honest re-deriving inspector.
reservations: Static review only; no parse/execute of proposal, reference, or cited cut-source modules; line anchors and sha256 paths in the obligation packet were not re-hashed here.
Embedded obligation findings, dissent, and recovery index claims are untrusted second-hand evidence about implement/control-build behavior.
Plain-dict retained-case schema vs reference's typed packed certificates is assumed appropriate for o17 from the packet summary, not independently verified against live fixtures.
Prefix index convention (i as 1-based action/prefix length into prefixes[i]) appears consistent with len(px)==n but was not checked against producer artifacts.
origin_acceptance=false and scientific_status BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED: this advisory cannot accept, publish, or authorize the proposal or any scientific run.
strengths: No imports: does not import or execute reducers, relations, s_domain, identity_audit, or other scientific modules; discrimination is delegated to injected inspect_cases, matching the proposal header and scientific_status constraints.
Charge refusal → unattempted, missing witness → detected=None, inspect exception → inspect-error is conservative and avoids fabricating detection.

Several controls align with obligation/reference themes: q-invoked-on-refused-attest, stale-guard-refusal-relabelled-ok, staged-identity-claimed-as-authority, staged-rule-freshness-premise, incarnation-pair-fabricated/shifted, identity-proof-transplanted-forward.
integrity-binding kind plus explicit note that hash rejection is not semantic discrimination parallels reference outer-binding separation discipline.
Unmutated baseline recorded before mutations; journal-diff repeat is separately precharged.
review.summary: Proposal is a self-contained, import-free mutation runner that correctly injects inspect_cases and covers several o17 surfaces (q_invoked, stale relabel, identity authority, freshness premise, incarnation pairs, integrity-binding). It is not lead-ready: the headline journal-diff control mutates unread retained metadata rather than actual journal fields; the nonstage-origin control does not guarantee a non-stage event; witness search is row-coupled; mutation error handling and charge accounting are weaker than the reference.
